purpose: Design document defining the abstraction of four forge wrapper skills that delegate document search and index updates to external backends (doc-link, doc-db).
summary: Overview: forge delegates search and indexing to doc-link or doc-db via four wrapper skills
Skill list: query-db-rules, query-db-specs, update-db-rules, update-db-specs with fixed categories
Query flow: resolve backend order, pick first available backend, no grep fallback, explicit errors
Output contract: Required documents path list built by script, common across backends
Query skill contract: inherited-type skill, allowed tools, args limited to keywords and short task text
Update flow: explicit backend option overrides selection, no switching on unavailability
Desired state: .doc_structure.yaml is authoritative; paths not included are removed from the index
Prerequisites: at least one backend usable, judged by capability not version
Test layout covering doc structure resolution, backend selection, doc-link contract, wrapper transparency
tasks: Modifying the query-db or update-db wrapper skills
Designing or changing backend selection behavior
Reviewing the document search output contract
Writing or updating tests for doc backend wrappers
Implementing skills that call query or update skills
Updating the document index after spec or rule changes
title: DES-001 文書検索ラッパー（forge → 文書検索 backend）設計書
